reasons: Datadog docker.net.bytes_sent is a gauge that reports the cumulative bytes sent per container, but the candidate applies rate() and returns bytes per second. The quantity and unit differ (bytes/s vs bytes), so the candidate does not match the Datadog value.

The matching OTel metric container.network.io.usage.tx_bytes is a monotonic cumulative sum in By. The converter should select it without rate(), e.g. sum by (container_name) (<selector>), so the value stays cumulative.

The candidate's sum by (container_name) is a reasonable collapse of the interface attribute, since the Datadog series is one per container. The avg in the source matches a single series per container, so the aggregation is equivalent.
The scope template variable has no prefix and default '*', so dropping it is correct. The container_name label is observed in the dataset, so the grouping label is valid.
